annotations.title: Deterministic Malformed JSON Syntax & Truncation Healer

description: Repairs broken or truncated JSON strings by stripping markdown fences, removing trailing commas, balancing unclosed brackets/quotes, and converting Python literals (None/True/False) into valid RFC 8259 JSON. Use when fixing syntax-broken JSON strings that fail JSON.parse(); for coercing field types and pruning extra properties on already-parseable JSON objects against a target JSON Schema, use enforce_json_schema_types instead. Read-only edge call (32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'malformed_json' (with enum defaults), uses '?demo=true' or L402 (50 sats); HTTP 400 if invalid.

malformed_json.description: Raw broken, truncated, or markdown-wrapped JSON string to repair.

repair_mode.description: Bracket-closing and literal-normalization strategy; defaults to 'heuristic_fast' when omitted.

name: heal_malformed_json

parsed_object.description: Deserialized JSON object produced from the repaired string.

repaired_json.description: Valid RFC 8259 JSON string after syntax healing.
